a_in, b_in, limit_in = map(int, input().split())
target_ratio = a_in / b_in
min_diff = 1e9
best_num = 0
best_den = 1

def gcd_calc(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

for i in range(1, limit_in + 1):
    b_value = (a_in * i) // b_in
    candidates = [
        b_value / i,
        abs(b_value - 1) / i,
        (b_value + 1) / i
    ]
    candidate_nums = [b_value, abs(b_value - 1), b_value + 1]

    for j in range(3):
        diff = abs(target_ratio - candidates[j])
        if diff < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff
            best_num = candidate_nums[j]
            best_den = i

if abs(1.0 - target_ratio) <= (abs(best_num / best_den) - target_ratio) + 1e-9:
    best_num = 1
    best_den = 1

g = gcd_calc(best_num, best_den)
print(f"{best_num // g}/{best_den // g}")
